description: Master slides for timelines: a horizontal rail, scroll-snap, a Gantt chart, a centre spine, sticky years, a stepper, a radial cycle and a metro map. Copy one into an Episode and replace the words.

slides.text: Timelines Eight reusable Slide layouts for showing things in time, with placeholder words only.
Timelines Eight ways to put events in order: three horizontal, three vertical, two that bend the line.

Timelines (1/8) Page 1 of 8 Horizontal rail Six milestones on one axis, labels alternating above and below. 01 2019 Kickoff 02 2020 Research 03 2021 Prototype 04 2022 Pilot 05 2023 Launch 06 2024 Review

Timelines (2/8) Page 2 of 8 Scrolling track A row of cards wider than the Slide: scroll or swipe, each card snaps into place. 01 06 Jan Kickoff Name the goal and the people. 02 06 Mar Research Collect what is already known. 03 06 May Prototype Build the smallest thing that answers a question. 04 06 Jul Pilot Try it with a few real users. 05 06 Sep Launch Open it to everyone. 06 06 Nov Review Measure, learn and decide what is next. 01 / 06
Timelines (3/8) Page 3 of 8 Phase bars Phases as bars on a shared time axis, so overlaps show at a glance. 1 2 3 4 Product Kickoff Prototype Research Research Review Operations Pilot Launch

Timelines (4/8) Page 4 of 8 Centre spine One spine down the middle, entries alternating left and right. 2019 01 / 06 Kickoff Name the goal and the people. 2020 02 / 06 Research Collect what is already known. 2021 03 / 06 Prototype Build the smallest thing that answers a question. 2022 04 / 06 Pilot Try it with a few real users. 2023 05 / 06 Launch Open it to everyone. 2024 06 / 06 Review Measure, learn and decide what is next.

Timelines (5/8) Page 5 of 8 Sticky years The year stays pinned on the left while its entries scroll past. 2022 ◆ 01 Kickoff Name the goal and the people. → ● 02 Research Collect what is already known. → 2023 ▲ 03 Prototype Build the smallest thing that answers a question. → ■ 04 Pilot Try it with a few real users. → 2024 ✦ 05 Launch Open it to everyone. → ◐ 06 Review Measure, learn and decide what is next. →

Timelines (6/8) Page 6 of 8 Stepper A numbered process: open a step to read its detail. Step 1 Kickoff , done Name the goal and the people. Step 2 Research , done Collect what is already known. 3 Step 3 Prototype , current Build the smallest thing that answers a question. 4 Step 4 Pilot , upcoming Try it with a few real users. 5 Step 5 Launch , upcoming Open it to everyone. 6 Step 6 Review , upcoming Measure, learn and decide what is next.

Timelines (7/8) Page 7 of 8 Cycle A timeline that returns to its start: six phases around a clock face. Jan–Feb Mar–Apr May–Jun Jul–Aug Sep–Oct Nov–Dec 01 / 06 Jan–Feb Kickoff Name the goal and the people. Name the goal and the people. Jan–Feb : Kickoff . Name the goal and the people. Mar–Apr : Research . Collect what is already known. May–Jun : Prototype . Build the smallest thing that answers a question. Jul–Aug : Pilot . Try it with a few real users. Sep–Oct : Launch . Open it to everyone. Nov–Dec : Review . Measure, learn and decide what is next.

Timelines (8/8) Page 8 of 8 Metro map Parallel lanes that branch and merge, read like a subway map. Product Research Operations 2019 Kickoff 2020 Research 2021 Prototype 2022 Pilot 2023 Launch 2024 Review
